categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the blood purification sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of blood purification equipment and consumables, as well as providing chain blood dialysis medical services. Its main products include continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) devices, hemodialysis machines, blood perfusion machines, dialysis concentrates, dialyzers, filters, and disposable blood purification consumables. Additionally, the company operates chain blood dialysis centers and offers intelligent blood dialysis management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent innovation with core technologies in blood purification equipment and consumables, including multi-organ support systems, precise liquid balance feedback control, precision peristaltic pump control, dual-channel replacement fluid input, non-invasive temperature measurement, multi-mode automatic switching, and consumable identification technologies. It has developed proprietary software control algorithms for its devices and holds numerous patents covering equipment, software, and consumables. Production is managed via ERP and PMC systems ensuring quality and traceability, with a focus on intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include tertiary hospitals (especially top-tier hospitals in China), medical institutions, distributors, and end patients suffering from end-stage renal disease and critical illnesses requiring blood purification. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products installed in nearly 400 large hospitals domestically and exported to over 90 countries and regions worldwide. The company also operates chain dialysis centers serving patients directly.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chongqing and has expanded its international presence to key markets including Southeast Asia, South America, Africa, Europe, and other emerging markets. It maintains a global sales and service network and actively pursues market access and registration in new countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the blood purification supply chain. It develops and manufactures blood purification equipment and consumables (midstream) and provides medical services through its chain dialysis centers (downstream). It also manages supply chain activities including procurement of raw materials, production, and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous investment in R&D to enhance core technologies and product innovation, focusing on intelligent and automated blood purification devices, expanding consumable product lines, and developing digital health management platforms integrating AI and big data. The company aims to maintain technological leadership, accelerate new product registrations, and expand international market penetration. It also emphasizes standard-setting participation and strengthening intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales and distribution of blood purification equipment and consumables, as well as providing medical services via its chain dialysis centers. The company employs a combination of direct sales and buyout distribution models domestically and internationally. It also earns income from after-sales services and digital health management solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the blood purification equipment sector, ranking first among Chinese brands in market share for blood dialysis machines and CRRT devices. Major competitors include international brands such as Fresenius, Baxter, B. Braun, Nikkiso, and domestic competitors like Jianfan. The company is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and growing international footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 567 million, a 17.8% decrease compared to the previous year, mainly due to policy-driven fluctuations in high-margin CRRT sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 70.9 million, down 63.55%. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains a strong cash flow position and has shown a three-year compound growth rate of 26.05% excluding one-off factors. R&D investment increased by 42.62% to RMB 54.2 million, reflecting a growth-oriented strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive blood purification solutions integrating equipment, consumables, medical services, and intelligent management systems, emphasizing safety, reliability, and technological innovation. Its products feature advanced multi-organ support capabilities, precise control technologies, and extensive patented innovations. The company’s integrated 'Internet+' service model enhances patient experience and operational efficiency, differentiating it from competitors by providing end-to-end solutions and strong after-sales support.
